facts.text: The oceanfront pool is the centerpiece of Shore House and has a zero-edge entry that resembles the gentle slope of the shoreline.

facts.text: The Shore House pool has sun loungers, day beds, private cabanas and an ocean-view jacuzzi.

facts.text: The pool has an open-air pool bar, and food and drinks can be delivered to your lounge chair.
facts.excerpt: Grab a cocktail from the mixologists at the open-air pool bar, or get food and drinks delivered to your lounge chair with a menu that highlights local cuisine.

facts.text: A stay at Shore House includes a dedicated concierge throughout the stay.
facts.excerpt: Your stay at Shore House includes a dedicated concierge throughout your stay to handle every detail, all so you can relish the moment.

facts.text: Concierge services include a dedicated valet and arrival experience, pantry stocking of your villa, itinerary curation and priority reservations across the resort.
facts.excerpt: Services include a dedicated valet and arrival experience, pantry stocking of your villa, curating an itinerary to immerse yourself in the local experience, priority reservations across the resort, and more.

facts.text: The Oceanfront Villa has panoramic ocean views from its veranda, a full kitchen, a washer/dryer and a stone bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Panoramic ocean views from your veranda, full kitchen, dining table, living room with sofa bed, washer/dryer, king bedroom with access to the veranda, and stone bathroom.

facts.text: Bay View Villas look out over Glorietta Bay from the veranda.
facts.excerpt: View of Glorietta Bay from your veranda, full kitchen with island and seating

facts.text: Resort View Villas have views of the Victorian building from a Juliet balcony.
facts.excerpt: Views of the iconic Victorian building from a Juliet balcony

facts.text: The 3 Bedroom Oceanfront Villa is described as the best villa in Shore House.

facts.text: Shore House guests have exclusive access to an ocean-view Bistro with indoor and outdoor seating.
facts.excerpt: Shore House guests have exclusive access to an ocean-view Bistro showcasing classic dining offerings with indoor and outdoor seating options.
